text:
emma: quick sync — we need a trimmed MVP for enterprise retention + evidence exports to unblock two pilots. goal: small, auditable, fast. @rory @nate please weigh in. :calendar:
rory: propose minimal MVP: tenant TTLs (30/90/365), signed export manifest (sha256 + signer id), BYOK pointer to KMS arn (no plaintext), and SOC2 checklist doc. no per-model TTLs in MVP.
nate: infra notes: signed manifest can use a platform signing key (rotateable). export pipeline: read audit stream -> pack JSONL -> compute file digests -> produce manifest -> sign -> upload to secure bucket. estimate 2 dev weeks + 1 week infra.
legal: must include admin action logs and key rotation events in export. manifest must include canonicalization rules and signature algorithm. Also need retention clause in T&Cs for pilot.
emma: acceptance criteria draft: 1) TTLs enforced across regions, 2) export produces signed manifest + files for any requested window, 3) BYOK handshake doc + one pilot test, 4) SOC2 mapping reviewed by legal. SLO: export delivery within 24h.
rory: UX: admin console needs TTL selector, "Request Evidence" flow with date range and a simple CSV preview option for legal. Also show BYOK status (uploaded/verified/active).
nate: risks: purge failures — we'll surface alerts and include tombstone entries in exports. also constrain export size and rate-limit.
infra-bot: automatic message 67 created ticket: EPIC-197777 (retention-minimal-mvp), assigned to rory, nate.
emma: owners: rory=product+ux, nate=infra+signing, legal=compliance. I'll coordinate pilots. Lock scope if no objections by EOD. :thumbsup:
